profile.summary: Principal Software Developer and Technical Team Leader with a proven track record of turning complex problems into elegant, scalable solutions.

positions.title: Principal software developer
positions.description:
WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION
•	Led team implementing warehouse execution system for multiple warehouses & customers using J2EE, Python, MS SQL Server, JMS. Mentored several junior developers. 
•	Created mobile workflow solutions for person-to-good picking for Zebra android devices
•	Automated warehouse initialization system identifying locations, divert points, scanners, zones, areas, etc. 
•	Managed delivery and maintenance of 4 warehouses using single code base. Previously, each warehouse would require a separate code base. 
•	Implemented host communication protocols to transfer wave data as well as user performance metrics

INSURANCE
•	Created and maintained a set of spring boot microservices deployed as Docker instances onto AWS ECS and Fargate.
•	Created NodeJS Lambda functions with associated DynamoDB databases. Lambda deployed using API Gateway.
•	Setup Serverless configuration for Lambdas.
•	Developed Python data loader utilities for populating static DynamoDB databases.
•	Setup Localstack AWS to allow for offline development & testing of services.
•	Assisted in creating NodeJS based deployment utility to make deploying 27 services easier.
•	Maintained Webflux reactive java based spring boot services.
•	Monitored services using Cloudwatch, Xray, ELK and Dynatrace.

VividCloud is a 100% US-based high-tech software services company. We provide software development services to help our clients with the digital transformation of their products by leveraging cloud computing, IoT, and data engineering technologies.

patents.title: Distributed publication system with simultaneous separate access to publication data and publication status information
patents.description: A publication system is disclosed for coordinating access to publication data and related information. The publication data typically includes text, image data and layout data. The related information is stored in an item header file, as well as in a number of records. The system includes a network of computers including computers dedicated to performing certain tasks related to obtaining publication data and such related information. To coordinate the publication process, the ability to modify text contained in an item file is limited while certain of the records that include useful information related to the same item file are separately available for other network users. The system also generates watch records to notify users of the current status of, availability of, or to provide other information related to, a publication item of interest. Algorithms are also disclosed for facilitating the writing and editing of text for an article.
